title: Maximum Product Of Three Numbers
description:
Given an integer array nums, find three numbers whose product is maximum and return the maximum product.
 
Example 1:
Input: nums = [1,2,3]
Output: 6
Example 2:
Input: nums = [1,2,3,4]
Output: 24
Example 3:
Input: nums = [-1,-2,-3]
Output: -6

 
Constraints:

3 <= nums.length <= 104
-1000 <= nums[i] <= 1000
